summary: The mathematics (the U_m coordinate Hopf algebra and its points) is genuinely new and reuses the existing upper-unitriangular matrix API. But roughly 100 lines of CommHopfAlgCat transport scaffolding are copied verbatim from GeneralLinear/Coordinate/HopfAlgebra.lean, and the bialgebra/antipode-law proof scripts are a third copy of the MatrixMonoid/GeneralLinear ones; both should be factored into shared constructions.
